title: Release gating heuristics and pin-management scratchpad
content:
Quick brain dump of heuristics / ops notes for upcoming rollout window (Q1 2026). This is a working scratchpad — lots of TODOs below. Intention: consolidate into an ops checklist and small automation scripts before the freeze.

Goals:
- Safety-first canary with clear signals for automated and manual stop decisions.
- Conservative pin strategy for dependent services to prevent ripples (eg. model weights + runtime kernel changes).
- Fast rollback path that SREs and on-call engineers can run with a single terminal session.

High-level plan (example ramp):
1) 1% traffic -> 10 min steady-state -> evaluate signals
2) 5% traffic -> 30 min steady-state -> evaluate signals
3) 25% traffic -> 1h steady-state -> evaluate signals
4) 100% if stable, otherwise hold and investigate

Notes: choose time windows depending on request variance; low-traffic regions may need longer windows (x2). For low-latency features, prefer shorter windows but more conservative percentages.

Key gating signals (primary):
- p50/p95/p99 latency — compare vs baseline (pre-rollout) using rolling 10m windows. Alert if p95 > baseline + 25% or p99 > baseline + 50%.
- Error rate (4xx/5xx/streaming failures) — threshold: >0.5% absolute increase or >3x relative to baseline, whichever smaller.
- Token-level output quality regressions — run spot evals (2–3 golden prompts) and compare BLEU/semantic-similarity; fail if >5% degradation on any critical prompt.
- Request-level divergence / hallucination indicators (heuristic) — if system detects unusual token patterns or repeated generation truncation.

Secondary signals (context-dependent):
- GPU OOM or kernel fallback logs coming from nodes in the hosting pool.
- KV cache hit-rate drop (indicates tokenization/model mismatch) > 20% drop.
- Unexpected change in cost-per-token > 10% (operationally relevant).

Decision matrix (simplified):
- Any primary signal tripped during 1%/5% -> immediate pause + page oncall -> rollback candidate evaluate.
- Primary signals during 25% -> auto-hold and run customer-impact probes + start mitigation runbook.
- Secondary-only anomalies -> hold and investigate; possibly roll forward if low risk and mitigations exist.

Pinning strategy (models + runtime):
- Always pin model weights (sha/immutable tag) for Dedicated/Private customers in config.
- Runtime library (inference runtime) pin: prefer major.minor.patch pinned in release bundle. If we must upgrade runtime with a model, do a paired rollout in same canary job.
- Example pin metadata format to store in release-manager: "model: wgt-2026-02-18-sha1234 | runtime: runtime-v2.3.1 | quant-profile: q8_4"
- Backwards-compat compatibility check: run smoke harness that starts a VM with the older runtime and sends a set of representative requests to new model to validate kernel fallbacks.

Rollback playbook (short commands):
- Identifiers: release-id (eg. rls-2026-03-01-42), canary-job-id
- Graceful rollback: 
  1) pause route: rlictl traffic route pause --route <route> --release <release-id>
  2) pin previous: rlictl releases pin --route <route> --release <previous-release-id> --force
  3) scale down canary pool: rlictl pool scale --pool <canary-pool> --replicas 0
  4) restart observability probes: rlictl probes restart --release <previous-release-id>
- Emergency rollback (fast):
  1) rlictl traffic route replace --route <route> --target-release <previous-release-id> --immediate
  2) oncall runbook: notify-team --channel #prod-rollouts --message "EMERGENCY ROLLBACK rls-<id> -> rls-<prev> by <owner>"

Operational checklist (things to verify before first 1%):
- [ ] smoke tests green against staging and canary infra (latency + correctness).
- [ ] release artifacts uploaded and checksummed (model sha + runtime bundle sha).
- [ ] run the compatibility harness for pinned runtime/model pairing.
- [ ] trace sampling configured (1% token-level sampling) and logs stored for 48h.
- [ ] golden prompts / eval set uploaded to CI and baseline metrics captured.
- [ ] alert thresholds set in pagerduty/monitoring and runbook links attached.
- [ ] communication: scheduled standup note + #prod-rollouts ping 10m before start.

Automation TODOs (short):
- [ ] small script to compute rolling baseline and auto-fill threshold suggestions for p95/p99 (python + prometheus query).
- [ ] harness to run golden prompt evals automatically at each ramp step and post results to the rollout ticket.
- [ ] CLI subcommand to pin model+runtime pairs into release-manager and annotate dependent services.

Small checklist for version pin notes to leave in ticket:
- model-sha: (sha)
- model-archive-size: (MB)
- runtime-image: runtime-v2.3.1
- quant-profile: q8_4
- dependent-services: [router-service-v12, cache-service-v3]
- known-incompatibilities: [cuda-llama-f16-kernel on A100-80GB if runtime < v2.2]

Observability probes to run during canary (examples):
- Single-request tracer that records latency + token count + kv-cache-hits. Run 1000 requests per ramp step.
- Golden prompt correctness check against precomputed embeddings; fail if cosine < 0.82 on any critical prompt.
- End-to-end user-path synthetic that touches the UI -> API -> model path for a small subset of customers.

Notes to self / open questions:
- Should we include a tiny negative-control population (0.1%) that uses an older kernel chain to better isolate regression sources? Pros: isolates runtime regressions. Cons: increases management complexity.
- How tightly couple release-manager pins with Console rollout UI? If loose coupling, easier to iterate; if tight, better visibility for product teams.
- Decision latency: how long do we allow SREs to respond before auto-pausing? Proposed default: 3 minutes during 1%/5% stage, 1 minute at 25%+.

Meeting action items:
- Jordan: prototype the threshold-suggester script by Mar 12 (prefilled prometheus queries + small CLI).
- Maya: add the golden prompts to the CI bucket and create access ACL for SRE.
- Ravi: validate rollback CLI commands in staging and produce a 1-page cheat sheet for oncall.

End of scratchpad. Will split into release-manager ticket checklist + short Confluence doc once we have automation prototypes.

Small snippet of the baseline prometheus query I want to use (for p95 latency):
"quantile_over_time(0.95, request_latency_seconds{route=\"/v1/generate\"}[10m])"

If anything is obviously missing or too conservative, drop a note here.
short_summary: Working scratchpad for gating heuristics, pin strategy and rollback playbook for canary rollouts. For eng-release and SRE iteration.
